Subject: Denver roadshow — last‑mile staffing & shuttle plan

Team / Liam,

Quick kickoff for the Denver stand this week — we have a sneaky night load-in on Thu and then full expo hours Fri–Sat. Primary asks:

- Confirm van coverage for badge run + two evening hotel shuttles (Wed night and Thu night)
- Finalize standby pool (local temps who can jump in for late arrivals)
- Assign point people for badge pickup (we need someone on Thu 5–6pm)

Current constraints: only one hotel block at the Marriott (12 rooms) and the vendor shuttle budget covers up to two 12‑passenger vans. We will likely need a short taxi stipend for any single-person late arrivals.

Attached is the current staff_roster.xlsx — names + shift windows. Please review and call out any conflicts.

Dylan
Field Events / Redwood Inference

Thanks Dylan — a few quick notes after scanning the roster:

- Recommend we identify two local standby contractors (I can ping the temp agency I used in April). They can cover the 6–10pm shift on Thu/Thu night load.
- For badge pickup: Mateo can pick up Thu at 4:30pm — he knows the venue contact (Greg).
- Hotel overflow: Shelly at HotelsPlus has one hospitality suite for 6 people if we need to consolidate (she's copied on this thread via separate email).

Kimberly — any concerns about the evening transport plan? If the vendor can only supply two vans, we might need to stagger drop windows to avoid long waits.

Hi all,

We can absolutely support two 12‑passenger vans for the core hotel ↔ venue runs both Wed and Thu nights. Attached is a preliminary van_manifest.pdf with proposed pick times and driver contacts. Notes:

- We can provide a backup driver on-call for Thu night for +$80/hour (if you want a guaranteed swap).
- Vans will have small luggage capacity — recommend limiting personal bags to one standard carry-on.
- If flights are delayed we can add an extra van at short notice (subject to availability).

If you want me to confirm drivers and lock times I can take payment info or a PO.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Event Logistics Co.

Date: 2027-06-07T06:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: AA delay — four arrivals affected (need shuffle)

Forwarding the flight update we just got from our travel partner — American has a delayed redeploy that pushes four inbound folks to after 10pm on Thu.

Quick proposals to cover shifts:

1) Swap: Move two on-site early shift volunteers (8am–12pm Fri) to cover the late arrivals' evening check-in/brief. Swap them with local standby temps for the morning shift.
2) Hotel swap: Put the four delayed staff at Shelly's hospitality suite (check-in by 11pm) and cover overnight with taxi stipends to avoid an extra van.
3) Escalation: If any of the delayed folks are presenting on Fri morning we should fly in an alternate presenter from SLC — low probability but needs a PLAN B.

Marissa / Mateo — can you confirm the standby names by 7am so I can lock vans and hotel rooms? Liam — if you can provision an extra van on-call that would be ideal — please confirm driver ETA if activated.

—Kimberly
Sr. Field Ops Manager

Thanks everyone — consolidated plan below (locking now):

- Vans: Liam to hold two 12‑passenger vans Wed/Thu nights; extra van on-call for Thu after 19:00 (Liam to confirm driver contact).
- Standby pool: Marissa to contract two local temps (standby_A, standby_B) for Thu evening cover; Mateo will confirm names by 07:30.
- Hotel: Shelly holds hospitality suite for up to 6 people; delayed arrivals booked into Marriott overflow + suite as needed.
- Taxi stipend: $40/person cap for single-person late arrivals; finance will pick up through expense policy.
- Badge pickup: Mateo to grab badges Thu 16:30 with Greg at venue.
- Final roster & shift swaps attached (final_itinerary.pdf). Please read and confirm any outstanding conflicts by 12:00pm Thu.

I'll post this to the shared Drive folder and update the HubSpot event record (HS-78921). Good work team — looks like we have a clean fallback if the delays get worse.

Dylan Brooks
